newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Televisa started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Televisa started as buy.

text.p: Caspian Research said it began coverage of Mexican media company Televisa with a buy recommendation, the brokerage said on Friday.
The brokerage's 12-month price target for the company is 140 pesos per CPO (certificados de participacion ordinaria), Mexico City analyst Martin Lara said in a statement.

"Markets have overly punished Televisa for a loss in market share and changes in management, and have not fully appreciated improvement in financial structure, strong recovery in the Mexican advertising market, and moves by the new management to make the company more profit-orientated," Lara said.
The company's shares have suffered in recent months, not improving when the media giant's aged leader Emilio Azcarraga Milmo stepped down a month ago and left his 29-year-old son in charge.
The brokerage estimates earnings per share in 1997 at 2.17 pesos, and 4.50 pesos for 1998.
Televisa's Mexico shares were up 0.40 peso to 100.20 pesos at midday, while American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) were down 1/8 to 25 1/8.
